text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has arrived. Facing a Kikuka Sho that has become a completely blank slate, Air Shakur wants to make sure everything is in order...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is vital.
Your growth rate here will shape your future.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I've restructured the menu from scratch. We'll make adjustments as needed, but this is the baseline we'll stick to.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...?
You sure are rarin' to go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, she's all fired up.
She's crammed all the data that might be needed for this training session into her head.
choice_data_list: (I want to be useful this time for sure!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in this scorching heat, Air Shakur can't just
keep tinkering with her computer forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To act as a PC when that time came,
I stayed up all night cramming all the data
we might need into my head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, I couldn't be of much help to her before the Japanese Derby. I need to grow as a Trainer during this summer training camp.
choice_data_list: Tell me anything, no matter what it is.
Tell me anything, no matter what it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I already know what I need to do.
I got nothin' to ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Can you at least carry the water bottles?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi.
Don't go overboard and pass out on me."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That right there.
That's seriously, totally pointless enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You definitely didn't understand a thing, did you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Somehow... with those two, you can't tell who's the trainer and who's not."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the summer training camp began,
blazing with the desire for further growth!
